entries.name: Alec Pierce
entries.summary: Colts head coach Shane Steichen said Wednesday that Pierce (heel) will be placed on injured reserve and is without a timeline for a return, Kevin Bowen of 107.5 The Fan Indianapolis reports.

entries.name: Andrei Iosivas
entries.summary: Bengals head coach Zac Taylor said Wednesday that Iosivas tore a ligament in his thumb and will be placed on injured reserve, Ben Baby of ESPN.com reports.

entries.name: Brandon Aiyuk
entries.summary: Head coach Kyle Shanahan said Sunday that he's not viewing Aiyuk as an option for the 49ers while the club contends with multiple injuries at receiver, Matt Barrows of The Athletic reports.

entries.name: Charlie Kolar
entries.summary: Chargers head coach Jim Harbaugh said Wednesday that Kolar (forearm) won't play Sunday in Buffalo but is expected to avoid placement on injured reserve, Kris Rhim of ESPN.com reports.

entries.name: Demarcus Robinson
entries.summary: San Francisco head coach Kyle Shanahan said that Robinson is facing a recovery timeline of 3-to-6 weeks after sustaining a high-ankle sprain in Sunday's 35-13 win over the Dolphins, Nick Wagoner of ESPN.com reports.

entries.name: Jaxson Dart
entries.summary: Head coach John Harbaugh said Wednesday that Dart (knee) will miss the rest of the 2026 regular season, but he didn't rule out a return for the playoffs if the Giants qualify, Connor Hughes of SNY.tv reports.

entries.name: Jayden Daniels
entries.summary: Commanders head coach Dan Quinn confirmed that Daniels will be out for Sunday's game against the Seahawks, but the quarterback remains without a precise timeline for a return while he continues to receive more medical opinions on his left elbow injury, Ben Standig of The Team 980 Washington D.C. reports.

entries.name: Jayden Reed
entries.summary: Reed (neck) has been ruled out for Thursday's game against the Falcons, Wes Hodkiewicz of the Packers' official site reports.

entries.name: Zach Charbonnet
entries.summary: Head coach Mike Macdonald said Wednesday that the Seahawks won't open Charbonnet's (knee) practice window this week, John Boyle of the team's official site reports.

entries.name: Caleb Williams
entries.summary: Coach Ben Johnson said Williams (hamstring) won't take part in Wednesday's practice, Courtney Cronin of ESPN reports.

entries.name: Dallas Goedert
entries.summary: Goedert (knee) was diagnosed Monday with a sprained MCL and is expected to miss a few weeks, Ian Rapoport and Adam Schefter of ESPN report.

entries.name: Mason Taylor
entries.summary: Jets head coach Aaron Glenn said that Taylor (thumb) won't participate in Wednesday's practice, Rich Cimini of ESPN.com reports.

entries.name: Aaron Jones Sr.
entries.summary: Jones (undisclosed) won't participate in Wednesday's practice, Alec Lewis of The Athletic reports.

entries.name: Aidan O'Connell
entries.summary: questionable

entries.name: Ashton Dulin
entries.summary: Dulin (ankle) did not participate in Wednesday's practice.

entries.name: Barion Brown
entries.summary: questionable

entries.name: Brenen Thompson
entries.summary: Thompson (quadriceps) did not participate at practice Wednesday.

entries.name: Brock Bowers
entries.summary: Bowers (knee) was listed as a limited participant at Wednesday's practice, Adam Hill of the Las Vegas Review-Journal reports.

entries.name: Caleb Douglas
entries.summary: Dolphins head coach Jeff Hafley said that Douglas (ankle) won't practice Wednesday, C. Isaiah Smalls II of the Miami Herald reports.

entries.name: Chig Okonkwo
entries.summary: Okonkwo (hamstring) remained sidelined at practice Thursday, Tashan Reed of the Washington Post reports.

entries.name: Chris Bell
entries.summary: Bell failed to catch his only target Sunday in a Week 2 loss to San Francisco.

entries.name: Chris Moore
entries.summary: questionable

entries.name: Colby Parkinson
entries.summary: Parkinson didn't participate in Wednesday's walkthrough due to a knee injury, Nate Atkins of The Athletic reports.

entries.name: Cooper Kupp
entries.summary: Kupp (back) was limited in Wednesday's practice, John Boyle of the Seahawks' official site reports.

entries.name: Dareke Young
entries.summary: Young (hamstring) is questionable to return to Sunday's game against the Chargers.

entries.name: DeeJay Dallas
entries.summary: Dallas (toe) was a limited participant at the Vikings' practice Wednesday.

entries.name: DJ Moore
entries.summary: Moore (shoulder) "felt great" after getting in a limited practice Wednesday, Matt Parrino of The Syracuse Post-Standard reports.

entries.name: Eli Raridon
entries.summary: Raridon (thigh) was a limited participant at practice Wednesday.

entries.name: George Holani
entries.summary: Holani (knee) practiced on a limited basis Wednesday, John Boyle of the Seahawks' official site reports.

entries.name: J.K. Dobbins
entries.summary: Dobbins (hip) was limited at practice Wednesday, Aric DiLalla of the Broncos' official site reports.

entries.name: Jadarian Price
entries.summary: Price (shoulder) will practice this week, coach Mike Macdonald said Wednesday, Curtis Crabtree of Fox 13 Seattle reports.

entries.name: Jakobi Meyers
entries.summary: Meyers (thumb) was listed as a limited participant for Wednesday's practice, Ryan O'Halloran of the Florida Times-Union reports.

entries.name: Jalen Coker
entries.summary: Coker (ankle) was limited in Wednesday's practice, Joe Person of The Athletic reports.

entries.name: Jaylen Warren
entries.summary: Warren (shoulder) was listed as a limited participant at Wednesday's practice, Alan Saunders of Pittsburgh Sports Now reports.

entries.name: Jaylen Wright
entries.summary: Wright (stinger/foot) was a limited participant at practice Wednesday, C. Isaiah Smalls II of the Miami Herald reports.

entries.name: Jaylin Lane
entries.summary: Lane returned six kickoffs for 120 yards and one punt for 14 yards in Sunday's 37-20 loss to the Cowboys.

entries.name: Jonah Coleman
entries.summary: Coleman (ankle) didn't practice Wednesday, Aric DiLalla of the Broncos' official site reports.

entries.name: Jordan Whittington
entries.summary: Whittington (quadriceps) did not participate in Wednesday's practice, Nate Atkins of The Athletic reports.

entries.name: Kaytron Allen
entries.summary: questionable

entries.name: Kene Nwangwu
entries.summary: Nwangwu (back) did not participate in Wednesday's practice.

entries.name: Keon Coleman
entries.summary: Coleman didn't practice Wednesday due to an ankle injury.

entries.name: Kyle Monangai
entries.summary: Monangai (undisclosed) was not present during the portion of Wednesday's practice open to the media, Brad Biggs of the Chicago Tribune reports.

entries.name: LeQuint Allen Jr.
entries.summary: Allen (hip) was a limited participant at the Jaguars' practice Wednesday.

entries.name: Malik Nabers
entries.summary: Nabers (shoulder) was seen participating in Wednesday's practice, Pat Leonard of the New York Daily News reports.

entries.name: Marvin Mims Jr.
entries.summary: Mims (foot) was a limited participant at the Broncos' practice Wednesday, Aric DiLalla of the team's official website reports.

entries.name: Michael Pittman Jr.
entries.summary: Pittman (foot) was a limited participant in Wednesday's practice, Brooke Pryor of ESPN.com reports.

entries.name: Mike Evans
entries.summary: The hip injury Evans sustained in Sunday's win over the Dolphins "does not seem to be major," and the wideout has a "good chance" of practicing Thursday and/or Friday and playing this weekend against the Cardinals, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.

entries.name: Nico Collins
entries.summary: Collins (hamstring) wasn't spotted at the media-access portion of Thursday's practice, DJ Bien-Aime of ESPN.com reports.

entries.name: Puka Nacua
entries.summary: Nacua, who was listed as a non-participant on Wednesday's estimated practice report, doesn't appear to be making much progress in his recovery from a groin injury and could be trending toward a second consecutive absence Sunday against the Broncos, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.

entries.name: Rico Dowdle
entries.summary: Dowdle (toe) was a non-participant in Wednesday's practice, Brooke Pryor of ESPN.com reports.

entries.name: RJ Harvey
entries.summary: Harvey (hamstring) was a limited participant at Wednesday's practice, Aric DiLalla of the Broncos' official site reports.

entries.name: Ryan Miller
entries.summary: Miller (hip/back) was a limited participant at practice Wednesday, C. Isaiah Smalls II of the Miami Herald reports.

entries.name: Sam Darnold
entries.summary: Seahawks head coach Mike Macdonald said after Wednesday's practice that Darnold (glute) is "on a good track" to play Sunday against the Commanders, Brady Henderson of ESPN.com reports.

entries.name: Saquon Barkley
entries.summary: The Eagles announced that Barkley (neck/shoulder) is questionable to return to Sunday's game against the Titans due to a stinger.

entries.name: Terrance Ferguson
entries.summary: Ferguson was limited at Wednesday's walkthrough due to an ankle injury, Nate Atkins of The Athletic reports.

entries.name: Tony Pollard
entries.summary: Pollard was a non-participant in Wednesday's practice due to an ankle injury.

entries.name: Travis Etienne Jr.
entries.summary: Head coach Kellen Moore said Etienne was a limited practice participant Wednesday due to a hamstring injury, Jeff Nowak of WWL New Orleans reports.

entries.name: Tyjae Spears
entries.summary: Spears was a non-participant in Wednesday's practice due to an ankle injury.

entries.name: Tyson Bagent
entries.summary: Coach Ben Johnson said Bagent (concussion) won't practice Wednesday, Kevin Fishbain of The Athletic reports.

entries.name: Zay Flowers
entries.summary: Flowers (hamstring) isn't participating in Wednesday's practice, Jamison Hensley of ESPN.com reports.

entries.name: Arian Smith
entries.summary: Smith (knee) underwent surgery Wednesday to repair a torn ACL and will miss the rest of the season, Antwan V. Staley of the New York Daily News reports.

entries.name: David Njoku
entries.summary: The Chargers placed Njoku (fibula) on injured reserve Wednesday.

entries.name: Jonathon Brooks
entries.summary: Brooks is expected to undergo surgery Wednesday to repair a core-muscle injury and is likely to miss at least six weeks, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.

entries.name: Ronnie Rivers
entries.summary: The Rams placed Rivers (calf) on their injured reserve list Wednesday.
